disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing fraud or deceit in obtaining a license or in connection with service rendered within the scope of the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud or deceit in obtaining a license under this chapter or in connection with service rendered within the scope of the license issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in endangering health or safety of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in the licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in performing duties in a manner that endangers patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or is foreseeably likely to result in the licensee performing the licensee's duties in a manner that endangers the health or safety of the licensee's patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of nursing by an unlicensed individual who claims to be legally licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of nursing by an individual not licensed under this chapter and who claims to be legally licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed, evidencing lack of ability, fitness, or knowledge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed. A licensee is considered incompetent in the practice if the licensee has: (1) Engaged in conduct that evidences a lack of ability or fitness to discharge the duty owed by the licensee to a client or patient or the general public; or (2) Engaged in conduct that evidences a lack of knowledge or inability to apply principles or skills to carry out the practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a standard of professional behavior established in the practice for which the licensee is licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct. A licensee is considered to have engaged in unprofessional conduct if the licensee violates a standard of professional behavior that has been established in the practice for which the licensee is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty, false statement, directly related to practice, or for which incarceration of one year or more may be imposed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to the limitations of Title 5, chapter 341, conviction of a crime that involves dishonesty or false statement or that relates directly to the practice for which the licensee is licensed or conviction of a crime for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of this chapter or a rule adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of this chapter or a rule adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements of Title 22, section 7253

definition_quote.value: The practice of "professional nursing" means the performance by a registered professional nurse for compensation of professional services defined as follows: A. Diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential physical and emotional health problems through such services as case finding, health teaching, health counseling and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being and execution of the medical regimen as prescribed by a legally authorized licensed professional...
definition_quote.quote: The practice of "professional nursing" means the performance by a registered professional nurse for compensation of professional services defined as follows: A. Diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential physical and emotional health problems through such services as case finding, health teaching, health counseling and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being and execution of the medical regimen as prescribed by a legally authorized licensed professional acting within the scope of the licensed professional's authority to prescribe medications, substances or devices

drug_authority.value: Certified nurse practitioners and certified nurse midwives who qualify as APRNs may prescribe and dispense drugs or devices in accordance with rules adopted by the board. CRNAs in critical access/rural hospitals may prescribe controlled substances (DEA Schedules III, IIIN, IV, V) for up to 4 days.
drug_authority.quote: A certified nurse practitioner or a certified nurse midwife who qualifies as an advanced practice registered nurse may prescribe and dispense drugs or devices, or both, in accordance with rules adopted by the board.

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - including Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP), Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM), Certified Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS), Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" includes a certified nurse practitioner, a certified nurse midwife, a certified clinical nurse specialist and a certified nurse anesthetist who are licensed under this chapter to practice advanced practice registered nursing.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" includes a certified nurse practitioner, a certified nurse midwife, a certified clinical nurse specialist and a certified nurse anesthetist who are licensed under this chapter to practice advanced practice registered nursing.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: The practice of "practical nursing" means performing tasks and responsibilities, by a licensed practical nurse, for compensation within a structured health care setting...under the direction of a registered nurse or licensed or otherwise legally authorized physician, podiatrist or dentist.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: A certified nurse practitioner who qualifies as an advanced practice registered nurse must practice, for at least 24 months, under the supervision of a licensed physician or a supervising nurse practitioner or must be employed by a clinic or hospital that has a medical director who is a licensed physician.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: A certified nurse practitioner who qualifies as an advanced practice registered nurse must practice, for at least 24 months, under the supervision of a licensed physician or a supervising nurse practitioner or must be employed by a clinic or hospital that has a medical director who is a licensed physician. The certified nurse practitioner shall submit written evidence to the board upon completion of the required clinical experience.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: A certified nurse practitioner or a certified nurse midwife who qualifies as an advanced practice registered nurse may prescribe and dispense drugs or devices, or both, in accordance with rules adopted by the board.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: For controlled substances listed in United States Drug Enforcement Administration Schedules III, IIIN, IV and V, a certified registered nurse anesthetist may prescribe drugs only: (1) For a supply of not more than 4 days, with no prescription refills

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs with prescribing authority may not prescribe more than 100 MME/day; not more than 30-day supply for chronic pain; not more than 7-day supply for acute pain (with limited exception for FDA-labeled stock bottles up to 14 days).
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. To a patient any combination of opioid medication in an aggregate amount in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents of opioid medication per day

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: Has successfully completed a training program or course with a curriculum prescribed by the board, holds a certificate of training from that program or course and is listed on the Maine Registry of Certified Nursing Assistants and Direct Care Workers

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Delegation of specific nursing activities and tasks to be provided by unlicensed assistive personnel. This paragraph may not be construed to require a nurse to delegate, or permit a person to coerce a nurse into delegating, specific nursing activities and tasks in any care setting against the nurse's professional judgment

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: This paragraph may not be construed to require a nurse to delegate, or permit a person to coerce a nurse into delegating, specific nursing activities and tasks in any care setting against the nurse's professional judgment or to prohibit a nurse in the exercise of the nurse's professional judgment from refusing to delegate specific nursing activities and tasks in any care setting.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical or vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state is recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical or vocational nurse, under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single-state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board may contract with other agencies, individuals, firms or associations for the conduct and operation of a nurse health program operated by a professional review committee as that term is defined in Title 24, section 2502, subsection 4‑A.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Nurses licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services within their scope of practice, in accordance with board-adopted rules governing standards of practice and appropriate restrictions for the various types and forms of telehealth services.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A person licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services as long as the licensee acts within the scope of practice of the licensee's license, in accordance with any requirements and restrictions imposed by this subchapter and in accordance with standards of practice.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: A certified registered nurse anesthetist is responsible and accountable to a licensed physician or dentist for aspects of anesthesia practice that require execution of the medical regimen as prescribed by that physician or dentist, except as provided in subsection 3.

military_education_credit_required.quote: The applicant: A. Served on active duty in the medical corps of any branch of the Armed Forces of the United States and spent an aggregate of at least 12 months rendering bedside patient care; B. Completed the basic course of instruction in nursing required by the branch of the Armed Forces of the United States in which the applicant served; and C. Was honorably discharged from active duty.
